na.p: Na alphabet is the 28th in 41 alphabets and it is also the 20th in 33 consonants. 'Nissita'- consonant- alphabet that is the end of 'Dantaja' Ta- Vaga in 5 Vagga and depends on the 'Pañcama' vowel. This is (1) 'Na' that changes from another letter. 'Na' comes from (āguṃ). (3) 'Na' that is made canceling (lopa). (4) The original 'Na" (no need to change and cancel). (5) (Paccaya) 'Na'. (6) 'Na' that explains "zero" by the way of Piṭaka mathematic. So there are 6 kinds of 'Na'. Tipi,11,324+325+326 na na(pu,na) [na+a. Na+nī+kvi] (Pu)(1) Lord Buddha. (Na) (2) Buddha, Dhamma, and Sangha. The three Gems. (3) Catching and binding. (Ti) (Āgantuka Bhikkhu) who is going well. (5) Full (house, etc.,). Na (bya) [rū.nhā-132. Nīti, sutta.nhā-372. Dhāna. Dhāna,ṭī.1147- See.] This is (1) 'Na' has a meaning of prohibition (Paṭisedha). (2) 'Na' has a meaning of rejection (Paṭikkhepa). (3) 'Na' that is meaningless just to fulfill the sentence to adorn the sentence. (4) 'Na' has a meaning of asking (Pucchana). (5) 'Na' has the meaning of comparison (Upamāna). 'Na' that has the opposite meaning/ (7) 'Na' that has another meaning (Añña). So there are 7 kinds of Na. Three factors of Na liṅa and Kāriyasabbanāma'na' is related to Ta. Tipi,11,327 na na(pu) [nī+kvi]. "N" group from Chanaḥ book.
